from __future__ import annotations
from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class UserCreatedData:
    o: str
    nul: str
    arr: str = None
    empty: str = None
    str: str = None
    dup_keys: str = None

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: dict[str, Any]) -> UserCreatedData:
        return cls(
            o=data.get("o"),
            nul=data.get("nul"),
            arr=data.get("arr"),
            empty=data.get("empty"),
            str=data.get("str"),
            dup_keys=data.get("dupKeys"),
        )

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "o": self.o,
            "nul": self.nul,
            "arr": self.arr,
            "empty": self.empty,
            "str": self.str,
            "dupKeys": self.dup_keys,
        }
